what_was_verified: vLLM 0.8.5 V1 is active; vllm/v1/sample/sampler.py computes raw_logprobs from logits before penalties/temperature.
generation_nll uses the sampled token id and the returned logprobs=0 entry directly, with no rescoring call.
A separate vLLM prompt_logprobs call on the exact saved token ids reproduces the generation logprobs, including the outlier positions (e.g. double token 11 = 0.252 in both).
The failure is therefore not a sampling-transform mismatch in the returned signal; it is a vLLM-vs-HF forward/kernel difference on a few low-margin tokens.

outlier_example.interpretation: The sampled token is top-1 in both, but its probability differs at a low-margin position. The same vLLM value is produced by an independent prefill/prompt_logprobs path, so the discrepancy is forward-kernel precision, not a sampling transform.

decision: BLOCKED. The frozen validation tolerances were not relaxed and the 20x3 smoke was not launched.
minimal_decision_needed: Accept a documented validation-reference change (e.g. a specific HF attention/precision configuration) and rerun this gate with a new commit; or
Revise the frozen numerical tolerance with a stated rationale before any smoke; or
Provide an exclusive GPU so vLLM's memory accounting and kernel selection are not affected by co-tenants (this does not by itself remove BF16 kernel differences).
